name: Premiere Parts
summary: Kaylaena Springbolt needs an order of engineering parts brought from Nami in Everlook. You are asked to make the winter run to collect it.

sections.title: Parts for Kaylaena
sections.body: Kaylaena Springbolt has trouble getting parts and building materials to her workshop. She asks you to retrieve her waiting order from Nami in Everlook.

sections.title: Nami's Question
sections.body: Nami has Kaylaena's order ready and wonders what the gnome is making. Kaylaena is trying to create a trinket to protect herself from rogues in duels.

faq.q: Who is asking me to get the parts?
faq.answer: Kaylaena Springbolt asks you to collect her parts order from Nami in Everlook.

faq.q: Where do I get Kaylaena's order?
faq.answer: Nami in Everlook has Kaylaena Springbolt's parts order.

faq.q: Why does Kaylaena need the parts?
faq.answer: Kaylaena has difficulty getting parts and general building materials to her workshop.
Nami wonders whether Kaylaena is still trying to make a trinket to defend against rogues in duels.
Nami in Everlook is holding Kaylaena Springbolt's parts order.

angles.text: As an engineer, you are asked to collect parts and building materials for Kaylaena's workshop.
Nami mentions Kaylaena's attempt to make a trinket for duels against rogues.
